description: Na₇SbO₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.40 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.45 Å) and three longer (2.78 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Sb is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.06 Å) and three longer (2.10 Å) Sb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Sb atom.
